round_summary: Root cause CONFIRMED with captured evidence (fix-01): the old classifyAndDispatch demanded 'ONLY strict JSON' and hand-parsed it; for 'Hi tell me something abstract' the live model returned a TRUNCATED JSON fragment {'action':'note','text':' (300-token cap, thinking tokens eating the budget) which parseJsonLoose rejected with 'no json in response'; for the two delete inputs the pool's keys hit transient 503 UNAVAILABLE which the one-shot same-key retry let bubble. ALL failure categories collapsed into the single outer catch -> the identical generic 'I could not handle that' the operator saw on all three inputs. fix-02 rebuilt dispatch on Gemini NATIVE function-calling following the Compass pattern (motionssalt/compass src/ai/agent.ts): real functionDeclarations, bounded multi-round loop, plain-text-with-no-function-call is the valid conversational outcome, distinct friendly fallbacks at every failure point, one-round resolution for explicit requests, deletes still confirm-gated. fix-03 added a declared delete_everything tool + root-capable deleteNodeTree + D:root callback branch. fix-04 verified exact-name topic delete resolves live.

fixes.name: Confirm exact failure mode with real captured evidence
fixes.reproduced_failure_literal: Verbatim current-prompt runs (configured model gemini-flash-lite-latest): all three inputs -> 'Error: Gemini 503: This model is currently experiencing high demand' (one-shot same-key retry hit the same 503, then bubble). Same prompt on gemini-flash-latest: 'Hi tell me something abstract' -> raw response literally '{"action":"note","text":"' (TRUNCATED mid-string at the 300-token cap) -> parseJsonLoose threw 'no json in response'. Every one of these paths lands in the same routeFreeText outer catch -> '❌ I could not handle that. Try a command from /help.' — the exact message the operator captured on all three inputs.
fixes.root_cause: Structural: (1) a demanded-strict-JSON hand-parsed classifier has no valid shape for non-actionable input, so prose/truncation/fences all throw; (2) maxOutputTokens 300 is eaten by thinking tokens on current models, truncating JSON mid-stream; (3) 503s were retried once on the SAME key then bubbled to the generic catch; (4) one catch for every category => one opaque message.
fixes.fix: Evidence only (rebuild is fix-02). Also confirmed gemini-flash-lite-latest 503-saturated, gemini-2.5-flash-lite and gemini-2.0-flash-lite RETIRED (404 no longer available), gemini-flash-latest healthy — model health is a live variable, hence the 5xx rotation hardening in fix-02.
fixes.tested: harness/fix01.mjs captured all raw responses verbatim before parseJsonLoose.
fixes.concerns: The live bot's configured model (wrangler [vars] GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-flash-lite-latest) was returning 503s at evidence time; the new 5xx-rotation across the 7-key pool absorbs this far better, but the operator may want to point GEMINI_MODEL at gemini-flash-latest if the lite alias stays saturated. Not changed in code — runtime config.

fixes.name: Rebuild classifyAndDispatch on real Gemini function-calling (Compass pattern)
fixes.fix: tools:[{functionDeclarations:[file_note, read_topic, export_pdf, delete_topic, delete_everything, delete_entry, edit_entry, browse_topics, help]}] with JSON-schema params; systemInstruction carries the tree + targeting rules (no more giant inline prompt); 4-round loop: geminiContent returns raw model content, functionCall parts execute via executeDispatchTool against the EXISTING handlers (autoFileNote, sendReadPage, doExport, confirmDeleteKeyboard flows, handleEntryAction), functionResponse parts feed back; zero calls => model text sent directly as the reply; fallbacks: missing content 'I'm here — could you say that again?', empty text 'lost my train of thought', round exhaustion 'I hit a snag thinking that through', per-tool failure 'That <tool> failed (<reason>). Nothing was changed'; all-terminal calls end in ONE round (quota-min principle); geminiOnce returns full data; 5xx now rotates keys after one same-key retry; legacy gemini() text-join preserved for transcription/auto-file/rewrite callers; deletes present confirm/cancel keyboards only — no auto-delete.
fixes.tested: Live end-to-end (real code, real tree, real keys): 'Hi tell me something abstract' -> conversational reply ('Consider how a shadow is not an object...'), no tool call, no error; full 6-input matrix in verify section.
fixes.concerns: One pool key (index 4) returned 401 during verification — rotation absorbed it transparently; operator may want to remove that dead key via Settings.
